title: Node analysis work is bounded
statement: Let $n,k$ be natural numbers, let $P$ be a set of coordinates among the $n$ coordinates, let $\delta$ be a positive learning parameter with $0<\delta\le 1/2$, and let $B$ be a batch of restricted examples of length equal to the restricted sample count for $P,k,\delta$. The node analysis work on $B$ is at most the node analysis work bound for $P,k,\delta$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite set $P$ of coordinates among the $n$ coordinates
Batch of restricted examples indexed by the restricted sample count for $P,k,\delta$
